_what: The client's design tokens: every colour, size and timing a screen draws with, read by ui/tokens.gd into Palette and UI. Claude Design's tokens replace this file; no screen names a value of its own. Each value cites the section of the design document it comes from, or says it is the client's.

alarm_fill.from: the client's: 21.8's alarm red deepened for text on it, since neither ink (4.39:1) nor paper (3.59:1) reads on #E2536B at 21.8's 4.5:1 (D72)

alarm_text.from: the client's: 21.8's alarm red deepened for alarm words on a panel, at 7.2:1 and APCA Lc 78 over either end of the sky (D72)

success_text.from: the client's: 21.8's success green deepened for words on a panel, at 7.3:1 and APCA Lc 80 (D72)

px_per_point.from: the base frame is 1080 pixels for a 360-point phone

control_points.from: 21.1 primary controls at least 9 mm, about 48 points

safe_top_points.from: 21.1 clear of the notch and the home bar

widest_control_points.from: the client's: a control's words wrap past this, so a button and 21.1's clear corners fit a 360-point phone at 20.8's 200% text

corner_clear_points.from: 21.1 clear of the corners: past 15% of a 360-point phone (54 points) either side of the lowest row, with a little to spare

banner_ms.from: the client's: how long a banner stays, unless the player keeps banners until dismissed (20.8)

rehearsal_pace.from: 20.8 a slower mode that runs the simulation at 75% speed

panel.from: the client's: panels opaque, so nothing of the world shows through text

sky_top.from: the client's: the day sky, paled

sky_bottom.from: the client's: the day sky, paled

shape._what: 21.2: every school has a shape as well as a colour, so a pair of schools stays apart by shape alone (20.8)

hold._what: 20.8: hold times adjustable. 23.5's Weave is a one-second hold, with a tap path beside it

steps.from: the client's: half to three times 23.5's one second

haptics._what: 21.8: a light tap on buttons, a medium pulse on abilities and pylon breaks, a success pattern on escape, a warning pattern on alarm. Each is [milliseconds, strength] pulses.
